participant_id.Description: SEEG patient label sub-NN; NN is the row (1-68) of the patient in the cell arrays of the original sEEG_data.mat.

source_index.Description: Row index (1-based) of the patient in sEEG_data.mat.

n_contacts.Description: Number of SEEG contacts in the patient's PLV/DFA arrays.

n_non_ez_contacts.Description: Number of contacts in the non-EZ contact mask (acceptcontHealthy).

n_ez_contacts.Description: Number of contacts in the EZ contact mask (acceptcontEZ).

non_ez_analysis.Description: HealthyEZcriteria column 1: patient selected for the non-EZ analyses.

ez_analysis.Description: HealthyEZcriteria column 2: patient selected for the EZ analyses.
